atpd identity import and export each expose one required implicit PathBuf positional with no #[arg] attribute
standalone atp contributes 99 #[arg] declarations plus ten required implicit positional fields across six parser structs and one inline hidden-command field
standalone atp recv and serve are distinct command variants that share RecvArgs and dispatch to run_recv with different persistence booleans
all six standalone atp parser structs use the same explicit parse_max_block_size_arg parser and MaxBlockSizeArg::Auto default for max_block_size
standalone atp retains hidden parser surface: two legacy delta-sidecar flags, three hidden auth-key-stdin flags, two hidden commands, and the delta-state-export implicit destination
asupersync root verbosity, quiet, debug, and config values are copied into CommonArgs but main dispatch passes only the command into run, so those four values have no downstream consumer
asupersync doctor recipe-list accepts --json but run_doctor ignores the argument payload and always renders the same list
asupersync contributes 174 #[arg] declarations plus 25 implicit positional fields; its eleven #[command(flatten/subcommand)] plumbing fields are intentionally excluded from argument-row counts
the 199 asupersync rows freeze parser population and struct-level dispatch only; they do not claim independent per-field dataflow or command behavior

cross_file_contracts.contract: clap enables derive only; wrap_help is absent, so rendered help is not allowed to gain terminal-width-sensitive wrapping during replacement
the clap env feature and all #[arg(env = ...)] bindings are absent; environment behavior is hand-written outside parser population
asupersync explicit format and color flags override auto detection; auto format consults CI then ASUPERSYNC_OUTPUT_FORMAT, and auto color consults NO_COLOR then CLICOLOR_FORCE then terminal state
asupersync root verbosity, quiet, debug, and config values are parsed and copied into CommonArgs but main dispatch consumes only format and color; none of those four root values reaches run
atpd --config selects the TOML path and optional or true start flags override loaded values; missing or unreadable configuration falls back to defaults with a warning
the documented ATP precedence manager belongs to the detached shared tree and is not wired to the standalone atp binary parser
standalone atp reads ATP_RQ_AUTH_KEY_HEX, SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_CERT_DIR, and HOME outside clap; these remain parser-independent behavior
atpd reads PROGRAMDATA for Windows default paths and HOSTNAME then COMPUTERNAME for diagnostics outside clap
offline_tuner initializes env_logger through Env::default after parsing and selects only the fallback filter from the verbose flag
asupersync alone consumes the ten-code semantic registry; atp maps all command errors to FAILURE, atpd returns Result, and offline_tuner exits 1 on errors
src/cli/atp_command_tree.rs exports 51 command variants but has no Parser root and no binary consumer; it must not be presented as user-reachable
